title: Hungary at a Crossroads: Nuclear Plant Stress and Cronyism Audit Test New… · 21 Aug
keywords: Hungary, Paks nuclear plant, Danube drought, energy security, 4iG, state contracts, anti-corruption, procurement review, post-Orbán, European Union, rule of law, investor confidence, Hungarian economy, energy transition, climate adaptation
notes: Hungary is facing two simultaneous crises that strike at the heart of its economic stability and democratic credibility. A Danube drought has forced output cuts at the country's only nuclear power plant, while a new government audit of a telecommunications giant's state contracts worth over 1.3 trillion forints has rattled investors. Together, the two developments are defining the early character of the post-Orbán political era.
